# The one sentence the config comment and the audit output carry (D-8.1).
_ADV_LOC_DEGRADED_SENTENCE="locality: local_voices — with one local family the companion is not an independent second voice (duplicate_voice, or not planned), so every security audit is DEGRADED_SECURITY_REVIEW; adversarial-review-gate.sh and verdict-derive.sh treat this envelope exactly as they treat any other."

# --- the budget gate (D-7.4, D-7.6): every planned voice at its catalog price ------------------------------------------
_ADV_BUDGET_TOTAL=0
_ADV_BUDGET_VOICES="[]"
_adv_budget_estimate() {  # <estimated input tokens> <role>=<hop>... → _ADV_BUDGET_TOTAL (cents) and _ADV_BUDGET_VOICES (JSON);
  # each voice: input tokens × input rate + 2000 output tokens × output rate (micro-USD per Mtok → cents: ÷ 10^10, each term
  # truncated, as the fixed-rate formula was). An alias with no catalog price falls back to 10 / 30 USD per Mtok and is said;
  # a zero-priced one estimates 0 and is said too.
  local tokens="$1"; shift
  local -a roles=() hops=() args=()
  local rv rows="" line c_in c_out total=0 voices="[]"
  for rv in "$@"; do roles+=("${rv%%=*}"); hops+=("${rv#*=}"); args+=(--alias "${rv#*=}"); done
  if (( ${#hops[@]} > 0 )); then
    rows=$(PYTHONSAFEPATH=1 PYTHONPATH="$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/adapters" python3 -W ignore::RuntimeWarning -m loa_cheval.metering.pricing \
      --catalog "${LOA_MODEL_CONFIG:-$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/defaults/model-config.yaml}" --config "${CONFIG_FILE:-}" "${args[@]}" 2>/dev/null) || rows=""
  fi
  local k _bv_role _bv_hop _bv_src _bv_in _bv_out _bv_cents
  for (( k = 0; k < ${#hops[@]}; k++ )); do
    _bv_role="${roles[$k]}"; _bv_hop="${hops[$k]}"   # (a role word and a validated hop name — the jq operands below are small)
    line=$(awk -v a="alias=$_bv_hop" '$1 == a { print; exit }' <<<"$rows")
    _bv_in=$(sed -n 's/.* input_per_mtok=\([0-9][0-9]*\) .*/\1/p' <<<"$line")
    _bv_out=$(sed -n 's/.* output_per_mtok=\([0-9][0-9]*\) .*/\1/p' <<<"$line")
    _bv_src=$(sed -n 's/.* pricing_source=\([a-z_]*\)$/\1/p' <<<"$line")
    if [[ ! "$_bv_in" =~ ^[0-9]{1,12}$ || ! "$_bv_out" =~ ^[0-9]{1,12}$ || "$_bv_src" == "unknown" || -z "$_bv_src" ]]; then
      _bv_in=10000000; _bv_out=30000000; _bv_src="fallback"
      log "budget: no catalog price for $_bv_hop ($_bv_role) — the fixed 10 / 30 USD per Mtok applies to this voice"
    elif (( _bv_in == 0 && _bv_out == 0 )); then
      log "budget: $_bv_hop ($_bv_role) is zero-priced in the catalog — estimated 0c"
    elif [[ "$_bv_src" == "stale_catalog" ]]; then
      log "budget: $_bv_hop ($_bv_role) has a stale catalog price (price_date older than 90 days) — used as given"
    fi
    c_in=$(( tokens * _bv_in / 10000000000 )); c_out=$(( 2000 * _bv_out / 10000000000 )); _bv_cents=$(( c_in + c_out ))
    total=$(( total + _bv_cents ))
    voices=$(jq -c --arg r "$_bv_role" --arg h "$_bv_hop" --arg s "$_bv_src" --argjson c "$_bv_cents" --argjson i "$_bv_in" --argjson o "$_bv_out" \
      '. + [{role: $r, alias: $h, estimated_cents: $c, input_per_mtok: $i, output_per_mtok: $o, pricing_source: $s}]' <<<"$voices")
  done
  _ADV_BUDGET_TOTAL="$total"; _ADV_BUDGET_VOICES="$voices"
  log "budget: estimate ${total}c over ${#hops[@]} planned voice(s) ($(jq -r 'map("\(.role) \(.alias) \(.estimated_cents)c") | join(", ")' <<<"$voices"))"
}

# --- advisory voices (D-7.4): after the counted voices, concurrently, one wall clock, findings only under advisory_voices[] ---
_ADV_ADVISORY_PIDS=""   # "pid=token" pairs of the live advisory walkers (the reapers kill only the process forked)
_adv_reap_advisory() {
  local e p
====

          exit 1
        fi
      done
    done
    if [[ "$CONF_LOCALITY" == "local_voices" ]]; then
      # shellcheck disable=SC2086
      _adv_locality_filter advisory $CONF_ADVISORY_VOICES
      [[ -z "$_ADV_LOC_KEPT" ]] || read -r -a advisory_planned <<<"$_ADV_LOC_KEPT"
    else
      read -r -a advisory_planned <<<"$CONF_ADVISORY_VOICES"
    fi
  fi

  # Budget pre-check (before API call per sprint Task 1.3). cycle-129 FR-7 (D-7.4, D-7.6): the estimate sums every planned
  # voice — the primary, the companion's first hop and each advisory voice — at its catalog price
  # (python3 -m loa_cheval.metering.pricing --alias); an alias with no catalog price falls back to 10 / 30 USD per Mtok,
  # said by name; a zero-priced one estimates 0, said too. One estimate from the diff's size, before any dispatch.
  local diff_size_bytes
  diff_size_bytes=$(wc -c < "$diff_file")
  local estimated_input_tokens=$(( diff_size_bytes / 3 + 500 ))  # bytes/3 for code, +500 for system prompt
  local -a _bvoices=("primary=${fallback_chain[0]}")
  if [[ "${CONF_COMPANION_VOICE:-true}" == "true" ]]; then
    local _bc
    _bc=$(_companion_chain "$(_companion_family "$(_adv_family_of "$model")")")
    if [[ "$CONF_LOCALITY" == "local_voices" && -n "$_bc" ]]; then
      # shellcheck disable=SC2086
      _adv_locality_filter companion $_bc; _bc="$_ADV_LOC_KEPT"
    fi
    [[ -n "$_bc" ]] && _bvoices+=("companion=${_bc%% *}")
  fi
  local _bav
  for _bav in ${advisory_planned[@]+"${advisory_planned[@]}"}; do _bvoices+=("advisory=$_bav"); done
  _adv_budget_estimate "$estimated_input_tokens" "${_bvoices[@]}"
  local estimated_cost_cents="$_ADV_BUDGET_TOTAL"
  if [[ $estimated_cost_cents -gt $budget ]]; then
    error "Estimated cost (${estimated_cost_cents}c) exceeds budget (${budget}c)"
    jq -n --arg type "$type" --argjson est "$estimated_cost_cents" --argjson bud "$budget" --argjson voices "$_ADV_BUDGET_VOICES" \
      '{findings: [], metadata: {type: $type, status: "budget_exceeded",
        estimated_cents: $est, budget_cents: $bud, estimate_voices: $voices}}'
    exit 4
  fi

  # Assemble context (cycle-124 FR-2: input budget follows the dissenter's
  # company; the estimate is logged BEFORE dispatch so a truncated diff is

from __future__ import annotations

# Overflow guard: max safe integer for cost calculation.
# Python ints are arbitrary-precision, but we enforce this for parity with loa-finn
# which uses Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER (2^53 - 1).
MAX_SAFE_PRODUCT = (2**53) - 1


def cli_cost_micro_usd(value: Any) -> Optional[int]:
    """Normalize a CLI's USD amount without binary floating-point arithmetic.

    Missing, malformed, negative, or unrepresentable telemetry is unknown.
    Fractional micro-USD is floored, matching config-based cost accounting.
    """
    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (str, int, float)):
        return None
    try:
        amount = Decimal(str(value))
        if not amount.is_finite() or amount < 0 or amount > Decimal(MAX_SAFE_PRODUCT) / 1_000_000:
            return None
        return int(amount * 1_000_000)
    except (InvalidOperation, ValueError):
        return None


@dataclass
class PricingEntry:
    """Per-model pricing in micro-USD per million tokens."""

    provider: str
    model: str
    input_per_mtok: int  # micro-USD per 1M input tokens
    output_per_mtok: int  # micro-USD per 1M output tokens
    reasoning_per_mtok: int = 0  # micro-USD per 1M reasoning tokens
    per_task_micro_usd: int = 0  # Flat per-task cost (Deep Research)
    pricing_mode: str = "token"  # "token" | "task" | "hybrid"
    # cycle-124 FR-4: prompt-cache rates. Anthropic bills cache reads at 0.1×
    # input (Fable 5.1: 0.025×) and cache writes at 1.25× input; the catalog
    # carries cache_read_per_mtok explicitly, cache_write derives when absent.
    cache_read_per_mtok: int = 0
    cache_write_per_mtok: int = 0
    # cycle-125 FR-5 (SDD §1.6): how the id was matched — exact | dated |
    # alias | hop. Additive; every pre-cycle caller sees "exact".
    resolution: str = "exact"

# shellcheck shell=bash
# =============================================================================
# tests/unit/adversarial-review-s3-helpers.bash — the whole-run harness shared by the cycle-129 Sprint 3 suites
# (adversarial-review-advisory.bats, -budget.bats, -locality.bats).
#
# main() is sourced and run with `invoke_dissenter` replaced by a stub keyed on the model (canned adapter envelopes + a
# valid single-voice verdict_quality sidecar, the shape the companion suite uses), a temp .loa.config.yaml, a temp
# catalog when a case needs one, no credentials (a keyless host) and the test's own ledgers. No model is ever called.
# =============================================================================

s3_setup() {  # <sprint prefix>
    umask 022
    S3_PREFIX="$1"
    SPRINT="${S3_PREFIX}-$$-${BATS_TEST_NUMBER:-0}"
    : "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:?BATS_TEST_TMPDIR not set — needs bats-core >= 1.4}"
    T="$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR"
    PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "$BATS_TEST_DIRNAME/../.." && pwd)"
    export PROJECT_ROOT
    OUT_DIR="$PROJECT_ROOT/grimoires/loa/a2a/$SPRINT"
    [[ ! -e "$OUT_DIR" && ! -L "$OUT_DIR" ]] || { echo "setup: $OUT_DIR already stands" >&2; SPRINT=""; return 1; }
    export LOA_MODELINV_LOG_PATH="$T/model-invoke.jsonl"
    export LOA_COST_LEDGER_PATH="$T/cost-ledger.jsonl"
    export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="$T" XDG_CACHE_HOME="$T/xdg-cache"
    export TMPDIR="$T/tmp"; mkdir -p "$TMPDIR"
    unset LOA_ADVERSARIAL_KEEP_WORKDIR LOA_ADVERSARIAL_RUN_TAG LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REJECT_SIDECAR_DISABLE \
          LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REPAIR_MODEL LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REAP_GRACE_SECONDS LOA_MODEL_CONFIG LOA_ADVERSARIAL_CLI_HOP_TIMEOUT \
          LOA_ADVERSARIAL_NO_FM_DERIVATION LOA_ADVERSARIAL_RUN_LOCK_GRACE_SECONDS LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REPAIR_BUDGET_SECONDS \
          LOA_ADVERSARIAL_DISABLE_FALLBACK LOA_ADVERSARIAL_COMPANION_WAIT_SECONDS _ADV_PGREP_BIN _ADV_FLOCK_BIN _ADV_REDACTOR_BIN
    local saved_root="$PROJECT_ROOT" _src
    source "$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/lib-content.sh"
    source "$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/compat-lib.sh"
    _src="$(sed 's/^\( *\)main "\$@"$/\1: main disabled for testing/' "$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/adversarial-review.sh")"
    grep -q ': main disabled for testing' <<<"$_src" || { echo "setup: the main trailer sed matched nothing" >&2; return 1; }
    eval "$_src"
    PROJECT_ROOT="$saved_root"; export PROJECT_ROOT
    local p v; local -a row
    for p in anthropic openai google; do read -ra row <<<"$(_adv_cred_aliases "$p")"; for v in "${row[@]}"; do unset "$v"; done; done
    export LOA_ADVERSARIAL_ENV_DIR="$T/env"; mkdir -p "$LOA_ADVERSARIAL_ENV_DIR"
    if _adv_cred_present anthropic || _adv_cred_present openai; then echo "setup: a credential alias is still present" >&2; return 1; fi
    export LOA_ADVERSARIAL_CLI_PROBE=both
    CONFIG_FILE="$T/loa.config.yaml"
    printf 'diff --git a/x.sh b/x.sh\n--- a/x.sh\n+++ b/x.sh\n@@ -1 +1 @@\n-a\n+b\n' > "$T/diff.patch"
    CALLS="$T/calls.log"; : > "$CALLS"
    declare -gA BEHAVIOUR=()
    # the repair round-trip is not under test here: every repair is unavailable (the payload stays rejected)
    _repair_finding_via_model() { return 1; }
    invoke_dissenter() {  # <sys> <user> <model> <timeout> <vq_sidecar> <type> [schema]
        local model="$3" sidecar="$5" b sev="ADVISORY"
        [[ "${6:-review}" == "audit" ]] && sev="MEDIUM"   # each gate's own vocabulary — no reject detour
        echo "$model" >> "$CALLS"
        b="${BEHAVIOUR[$model]:-ok}"
        case "$b" in
            ok)
                [[ -n "$sidecar" ]] && _s3_vq "$model" ok > "$sidecar"
                jq -nc --arg m "$model" --arg s "$sev" \
                  '{content: ({findings: [{id: "DISS-001", severity: $s, category: "error-handling", anchor: "x.sh:10",
                     description: ("from " + $m + "."), failure_mode: "fm"}]} | tojson),
                    tokens_input: 100, tokens_output: 20, cost_usd: 0.0123, latency_ms: 5, schema_enforced: false}'
                return 0 ;;
            two)   # one finding that matches the counted one (same file, overlapping lines, same category), one on another line,
                   # one on the same line in another category
                [[ -n "$sidecar" ]] && _s3_vq "$model" ok > "$sidecar"
                jq -nc --arg m "$model" --arg s "$sev" '{content: ({findings: [
                    {id: "DISS-001", severity: $s, category: "error-handling", anchor: "x.sh:9-12", description: ("dup from " + $m + "."), failure_mode: "fm"},
                    {id: "DISS-002", severity: $s, category: "error-handling", anchor: "x.sh:40", description: ("new from " + $m + "."), failure_mode: "fm"},
                    {id: "DISS-003", severity: $s, category: "performance", anchor: "x.sh:10", description: ("other category from " + $m + "."), failure_mode: "fm"}]} | tojson),
                    tokens_input: 100, tokens_output: 20, cost_usd: 0.002, latency_ms: 5, schema_enforced: false}'
                return 0 ;;
            reject)   # a payload the normaliser cannot save (no severity)
                [[ -n "$sidecar" ]] && _s3_vq "$model" ok > "$sidecar"
                jq -nc '{content: "{\"findings\":[{\"title\":\"no severity\",\"category\":\"other\",\"description\":\"Something fails.\"}]}", tokens_input: 5, tokens_output: 5, cost_usd: 0.001, latency_ms: 1, schema_enforced: false}'
                return 0 ;;
            fail)  [[ -n "$sidecar" ]] && _s3_vq "$model" fail ProviderUnavailable 1 > "$sidecar"; return 1 ;;
            malformed) [[ -n "$sidecar" ]] && _s3_vq "$model" ok > "$sidecar"; jq -nc '{content: "not json", tokens_input: 1, tokens_output: 1, cost_usd: 0, latency_ms: 1, schema_enforced: false}'; return 0 ;;
            slow)  bash -c 'exec -a "$0" sleep 300' "loa-s3adv-slow-$$"; return 0 ;;
            *) echo "stub: no arm for '$b'" >&2; return 99 ;;
        esac
    }
    _s3_vq() {  # <voice> <ok|fail> [reason] [exit]
        if [[ "$2" == ok ]]; then
            jq -nc --arg v "$1" '{status:"APPROVED",consensus_outcome:"consensus",truncation_waiver_applied:false,voices_planned:1,voices_succeeded:1,voices_succeeded_ids:[$v],voices_dropped:[],chain_health:"ok",confidence_floor:"low",rationale:"stub",single_voice_call:true}'
        else
            jq -nc --arg v "$1" --arg r "$3" --argjson e "$4" '{status:"FAILED",consensus_outcome:"consensus",truncation_waiver_applied:false,voices_planned:1,voices_succeeded:0,voices_succeeded_ids:[],voices_dropped:[{voice:$v,reason:$r,exit_code:$e,blocker_risk:"unknown"}],chain_health:"exhausted",confidence_floor:"low",rationale:"stub",single_voice_call:true}'
        fi
    }
    export PYTHONPATH="$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/adapters"
}

s3_teardown() {
    pkill -KILL -f "loa-s3adv-slow-$$"'( |$)' 2>/dev/null || true
    [[ -n "${SPRINT:-}" && "$SPRINT" == "${S3_PREFIX:-x}"-* && -n "${PROJECT_ROOT:-}" ]] || return 0
    local d="$PROJECT_ROOT/grimoires/loa/a2a/$SPRINT"
    if [[ -d "$d" && ! -L "$d" ]]; then find "$d" -mindepth 1 -delete; rmdir "$d"; fi
    return 0
}

s3_config() {  # <yaml body> → the test's .loa.config.yaml (owner-only)
    printf '%s\n' "$1" > "$CONFIG_FILE"
}

s3_run() {  # <review|audit> → main's stdout (main runs in a subshell: it exits); stderr to $T/stderr.log; the status in $T/rc
    local rc=0
    ( main --type "${1:-review}" --sprint-id "$SPRINT" --diff-file "$T/diff.patch" --json ) 2> "$T/stderr.log" || rc=$?
    printf '%s' "$rc" > "$T/rc"
}

s3_norm() {  # <envelope file> → the envelope without advisory_voices, keys sorted, and only the clock-dependent fields removed
    # (the normalised compare: a timestamp and the repairs' measured wall seconds differ between any two runs, advisory or not)
    jq -S 'del(.advisory_voices) | walk(if type == "object" then del(.timestamp, .ts_utc, .repair_wall_seconds) else . end)' "$1"
}

#!/usr/bin/env bats
# =============================================================================
# tests/unit/adversarial-review-advisory.bats — cycle-129 Sprint 3 Task 3.3 (PRD FR-7 AC-7.3, SDD D-7.4, DEC-0165, DEC-0155).
#
# Advisory voices run after the counted voices on the same prompts, concurrently, under one wall clock; their findings
# live ONLY under advisory_voices[].findings (voice: advisory, counted_as: advisory_voice, duplicate_of links); the rest of
# the envelope and the verdict-derive output are byte-identical (normalised: timestamps removed) with and without them;
# a failed or timed-out advisory voice is a status, never a verdict input; an attempt to count one is refused by name.
# Mock mode: invoke_dissenter is the harness stub (tests/unit/adversarial-review-s3-helpers.bash) — no model is called.
# =============================================================================

load adversarial-review-s3-helpers

setup() { export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR"; s3_setup sprint-s3adv; }   # (the CLI lock is this test's own — CMP-121)
teardown() { s3_teardown; }

_base_cfg() {  # [extra lines for the code_review block]
    s3_config "flatline_protocol:
  code_review:
    enabled: true
    model: gpt-5.5-pro
    budget_cents: 500
    timeout_seconds: 30
    fallback_chain: []
${1:-}"
}

_feedback() {  # an approved review next to the envelope, for verdict-derive
    mkdir -p "$OUT_DIR"
    printf '%s\n' 'All good' '' 'No issues found.' \
      '<!-- LOA-VERDICT {"gate":"review","verdict":"APPROVED","counts":{"critical":0,"high":0,"medium":0,"low":0},"sprint_id":"sprint-x","ts":"2026-10-14T00:00:00Z"} -->' \
      > "$OUT_DIR/engineer-feedback.md"
}

_vd() {  # → verdict-derive's --json output on the standing envelope (status recorded, output kept whatever it is)
    "$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/verdict-derive.sh" --file "$OUT_DIR/engineer-feedback.md" --gate review --json 2>"$T/vd.err" || true
}

@test "ADV-1 an advisory voice's findings are present only under advisory_voices[].findings, tagged and linked by duplicate_of" {
    _base_cfg "    advisory_voices: [adv-two]"
    BEHAVIOUR[adv-two]=two
    result=$(s3_run review)
    [ "$(cat "$T/rc")" = "0" ] || { cat "$T/stderr.log"; return 1; }
    env="$OUT_DIR/adversarial-review.json"
    # the counted voices are untouched: primary + companion, nothing advisory at the top level
    [ "$(jq '.findings | length' "$env")" = "2" ]
    [ "$(jq '[.findings[] | select(.voice == "advisory")] | length' "$env")" = "0" ]
    [ "$(jq '.verdict_quality.voices_planned' "$env")" = "2" ]
    # the block
    [ "$(jq '.advisory_voices | length' "$env")" = "1" ]
    [ "$(jq -r '.advisory_voices[0].alias' "$env")" = "adv-two" ]
    [ "$(jq -r '.advisory_voices[0].status' "$env")" = "succeeded" ]
    [ "$(jq -r '.advisory_voices[0].counted_as' "$env")" = "advisory_voice" ]
    [ "$(jq '.advisory_voices[0].findings | length' "$env")" = "3" ]
    [ "$(jq -r '[.advisory_voices[0].findings[].voice] | unique | join(",")' "$env")" = "advisory" ]
    [ "$(jq -r '[.advisory_voices[0].findings[].id] | join(",")' "$env")" = "DISS-A1-001,DISS-A1-002,DISS-A1-003" ]
    # same file, overlapping lines (9-12 over 10), same category → the counted primary finding; else null
    [ "$(jq -r '.advisory_voices[0].findings[0].duplicate_of' "$env")" = "DISS-001" ]
    [ "$(jq -r '.advisory_voices[0].findings[1].duplicate_of' "$env")" = "null" ]   # (line 40: no overlap)
    [ "$(jq -r '.advisory_voices[0].findings[2].duplicate_of' "$env")" = "null" ]   # (same line, another category)
    [ "$(jq -r '.advisory_voices[0].findings[0].answered_by' "$env")" = "adv-two" ]
    grep -qx "adv-two" "$CALLS"
    # stdout carries the same envelope
    [ "$(jq '.advisory_voices | length' <<<"$result")" = "1" ]
}

@test "ADV-2 the envelope without advisory_voices and the verdict-derive --json output are byte-identical with and without advisory voices" {
    _feedback
    BEHAVIOUR[adv-two]=two; BEHAVIOUR[adv-reject]=reject; BEHAVIOUR[adv-fail]=fail
    _base_cfg
    s3_run review >/dev/null
    [ "$(cat "$T/rc")" = "0" ] || { cat "$T/stderr.log"; return 1; }
    cp "$OUT_DIR/adversarial-review.json" "$T/without.json"
    _vd > "$T/vd-without.json"
    ls "$OUT_DIR" | LC_ALL=C sort > "$T/ls-without"
    _base_cfg "    advisory_voices: [adv-two, adv-reject, adv-fail]"
    s3_run review >/dev/null
    [ "$(cat "$T/rc")" = "0" ] || { cat "$T/stderr.log"; return 1; }
    cp "$OUT_DIR/adversarial-review.json" "$T/with.json"
    _vd > "$T/vd-with.json"
    ls "$OUT_DIR" | LC_ALL=C sort > "$T/ls-with"
    [ "$(jq '.advisory_voices | length' "$T/with.json")" = "3" ]
    jq -e 'has("advisory_voices") | not' "$T/without.json" >/dev/null
    # the normalised envelopes (advisory_voices deleted, timestamps removed, keys sorted) are byte-identical
    diff <(s3_norm "$T/without.json") <(s3_norm "$T/with.json")
    # …and each named input on its own, so a failure names it
    local k
    for k in '.findings' '.verdict_quality' '.verdict_quality.voices_planned' '.verdict_quality.voices_succeeded' \
             '.metadata.companion_voice' '.metadata.rejected_summary' '.metadata.rejected_sidecars' '.metadata.cost_usd'; do
        [ "$(jq -cS "$k" "$T/without.json")" = "$(jq -cS "$k" "$T/with.json")" ] || { echo "differs: $k"; return 1; }
    done
    # verdict-derive reads the same envelope and sidecars: its --json output is byte-identical
    [ -s "$T/vd-without.json" ]
    diff "$T/vd-without.json" "$T/vd-with.json"
    # the advisory voice's rejected payload never landed beside the envelope (verdict-derive would count it)
    diff "$T/ls-without" "$T/ls-with"
    [ "$(jq -r '.advisory_voices[] | select(.alias == "adv-reject") | .rejected_count' "$T/with.json")" = "1" ]
}

@test "ADV-3 a failed or malformed advisory voice is recorded under advisory_voices[].status and ignored by verdict quality" {
    BEHAVIOUR[adv-fail]=fail; BEHAVIOUR[adv-bad]=malformed
    _base_cfg "    advisory_voices: [adv-fail, adv-bad]"
    s3_run review >/dev/null
    [ "$(cat "$T/rc")" = "0" ] || { cat "$T/stderr.log"; return 1; }
    env="$OUT_DIR/adversarial-review.json"
    [ "$(jq -r '[.advisory_voices[].status] | join(",")' "$env")" = "failed,failed" ]
    [ "$(jq '[.advisory_voices[].findings | length] | add' "$env")" = "0" ]
    [ "$(jq -r '.verdict_quality.status' "$env")" = "APPROVED" ]
    [ "$(jq '.verdict_quality.voices_planned' "$env")" = "2" ]
    [ "$(jq '.verdict_quality.voices_succeeded' "$env")" = "2" ]
    [ "$(jq '[.verdict_quality.voices_dropped[]?.voice] | map(select(test("adv-"))) | length' "$env")" = "0" ]
}

@test "ADV-4 the advisory wall clock is honoured: a voice still running is killed and timed_out while a fast one completes" {
    BEHAVIOUR[adv-slow]=slow; BEHAVIOUR[adv-two]=two
    _base_cfg "    advisory_voices: [adv-slow, adv-two]
    advisory_timeout_seconds: 2"
    local t0 t1; t0=$(date +%s)
    s3_run review >/dev/null
    t1=$(date +%s)
    [ "$(cat "$T/rc")" = "0" ] || { cat "$T/stderr.log"; return 1; }
    (( t1 - t0 < 60 ))
    env="$OUT_DIR/adversarial-review.json"
    [ "$(jq -r '.advisory_voices[0].status' "$env")" = "timed_out" ]
    [ "$(jq -r '.advisory_voices[1].status' "$env")" = "succeeded" ]
    grep -q "Advisory voice adv-slow: still running at the 2s advisory wall clock — killed (timed_out)" "$T/stderr.log"
    # the hung hop did not outlive the run
    sleep 0.5
    ! pgrep -f "loa-s3adv-slow-$$" >/dev/null || { echo "the hung advisory hop outlived the run"; return 1; }
    [ "$(jq '.verdict_quality.voices_planned' "$env")" = "2" ]
}

# shellcheck shell=bash
# =============================================================================
# tests/unit/adversarial-review-s3-helpers.bash — the whole-run harness shared by the cycle-129 Sprint 3 suites
# (adversarial-review-advisory.bats, -budget.bats, -locality.bats).
#
# main() is sourced and run with `invoke_dissenter` replaced by a stub keyed on the model (canned adapter envelopes + a
# valid single-voice verdict_quality sidecar, the shape the companion suite uses), a temp .loa.config.yaml, a temp
# catalog when a case needs one, no credentials (a keyless host) and the test's own ledgers. No model is ever called.
# =============================================================================

s3_setup() {  # <sprint prefix>
    umask 022
    S3_PREFIX="$1"
    SPRINT="${S3_PREFIX}-$$-${BATS_TEST_NUMBER:-0}"
    : "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:?BATS_TEST_TMPDIR not set — needs bats-core >= 1.4}"
    T="$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR"
    PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "$BATS_TEST_DIRNAME/../.." && pwd)"
    export PROJECT_ROOT
    OUT_DIR="$PROJECT_ROOT/grimoires/loa/a2a/$SPRINT"
    [[ ! -e "$OUT_DIR" && ! -L "$OUT_DIR" ]] || { echo "setup: $OUT_DIR already stands" >&2; SPRINT=""; return 1; }
    export LOA_MODELINV_LOG_PATH="$T/model-invoke.jsonl"
    export LOA_COST_LEDGER_PATH="$T/cost-ledger.jsonl"
    export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="$T" XDG_CACHE_HOME="$T/xdg-cache"
    export TMPDIR="$T/tmp"; mkdir -p "$TMPDIR"
    unset LOA_ADVERSARIAL_KEEP_WORKDIR LOA_ADVERSARIAL_RUN_TAG LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REJECT_SIDECAR_DISABLE \
          LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REPAIR_MODEL LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REAP_GRACE_SECONDS LOA_MODEL_CONFIG LOA_ADVERSARIAL_CLI_HOP_TIMEOUT \
          LOA_ADVERSARIAL_NO_FM_DERIVATION LOA_ADVERSARIAL_RUN_LOCK_GRACE_SECONDS LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REPAIR_BUDGET_SECONDS \
          LOA_ADVERSARIAL_DISABLE_FALLBACK LOA_ADVERSARIAL_COMPANION_WAIT_SECONDS _ADV_PGREP_BIN _ADV_FLOCK_BIN _ADV_REDACTOR_BIN
    local saved_root="$PROJECT_ROOT" _src
    source "$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/lib-content.sh"
    source "$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/compat-lib.sh"
    _src="$(sed 's/^\( *\)main "\$@"$/\1: main disabled for testing/' "$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/adversarial-review.sh")"
    grep -q ': main disabled for testing' <<<"$_src" || { echo "setup: the main trailer sed matched nothing" >&2; return 1; }
    eval "$_src"
    PROJECT_ROOT="$saved_root"; export PROJECT_ROOT
    local p v; local -a row
    for p in anthropic openai google; do read -ra row <<<"$(_adv_cred_aliases "$p")"; for v in "${row[@]}"; do unset "$v"; done; done
    export LOA_ADVERSARIAL_ENV_DIR="$T/env"; mkdir -p "$LOA_ADVERSARIAL_ENV_DIR"
    if _adv_cred_present anthropic || _adv_cred_present openai; then echo "setup: a credential alias is still present" >&2; return 1; fi
    export LOA_ADVERSARIAL_CLI_PROBE=both
    CONFIG_FILE="$T/loa.config.yaml"
    printf 'diff --git a/x.sh b/x.sh\n--- a/x.sh\n+++ b/x.sh\n@@ -1 +1 @@\n-a\n+b\n' > "$T/diff.patch"
    CALLS="$T/calls.log"; : > "$CALLS"
    declare -gA BEHAVIOUR=()
    # the repair round-trip is not under test here: every repair is unavailable (the payload stays rejected)
    _repair_finding_via_model() { return 1; }
    invoke_dissenter() {  # <sys> <user> <model> <timeout> <vq_sidecar> <type> [schema]
        local model="$3" sidecar="$5" b sev="ADVISORY"
        [[ "${6:-review}" == "audit" ]] && sev="MEDIUM"   # each gate's own vocabulary — no reject detour
        echo "$model" >> "$CALLS"
        b="${BEHAVIOUR[$model]:-ok}"
        case "$b" in
            ok)
                [[ -n "$sidecar" ]] && _s3_vq "$model" ok > "$sidecar"
                jq -nc --arg m "$model" --arg s "$sev" \
                  '{content: ({findings: [{id: "DISS-001", severity: $s, category: "error-handling", anchor: "x.sh:10",
                     description: ("from " + $m + "."), failure_mode: "fm"}]} | tojson),
                    tokens_input: 100, tokens_output: 20, cost_usd: 0.0123, latency_ms: 5, schema_enforced: false}'
                return 0 ;;
            two)   # one finding that matches the counted one (same file, overlapping lines, same category), one on another line,
                   # one on the same line in another category
                [[ -n "$sidecar" ]] && _s3_vq "$model" ok > "$sidecar"
                jq -nc --arg m "$model" --arg s "$sev" '{content: ({findings: [
                    {id: "DISS-001", severity: $s, category: "error-handling", anchor: "x.sh:9-12", description: ("dup from " + $m + "."), failure_mode: "fm"},
                    {id: "DISS-002", severity: $s, category: "error-handling", anchor: "x.sh:40", description: ("new from " + $m + "."), failure_mode: "fm"},
                    {id: "DISS-003", severity: $s, category: "performance", anchor: "x.sh:10", description: ("other category from " + $m + "."), failure_mode: "fm"}]} | tojson),
                    tokens_input: 100, tokens_output: 20, cost_usd: 0.002, latency_ms: 5, schema_enforced: false}'
                return 0 ;;
            reject)   # a payload the normaliser cannot save (no severity)
                [[ -n "$sidecar" ]] && _s3_vq "$model" ok > "$sidecar"
                jq -nc '{content: "{\"findings\":[{\"title\":\"no severity\",\"category\":\"other\",\"description\":\"Something fails.\"}]}", tokens_input: 5, tokens_output: 5, cost_usd: 0.001, latency_ms: 1, schema_enforced: false}'
                return 0 ;;
            fail)  [[ -n "$sidecar" ]] && _s3_vq "$model" fail ProviderUnavailable 1 > "$sidecar"; return 1 ;;
            malformed) [[ -n "$sidecar" ]] && _s3_vq "$model" ok > "$sidecar"; jq -nc '{content: "not json", tokens_input: 1, tokens_output: 1, cost_usd: 0, latency_ms: 1, schema_enforced: false}'; return 0 ;;
            slow)  bash -c 'exec -a "$0" sleep 300' "loa-s3adv-slow-$$"; return 0 ;;
            *) echo "stub: no arm for '$b'" >&2; return 99 ;;
        esac
    }
    _s3_vq() {  # <voice> <ok|fail> [reason] [exit]
        if [[ "$2" == ok ]]; then
            jq -nc --arg v "$1" '{status:"APPROVED",consensus_outcome:"consensus",truncation_waiver_applied:false,voices_planned:1,voices_succeeded:1,voices_succeeded_ids:[$v],voices_dropped:[],chain_health:"ok",confidence_floor:"low",rationale:"stub",single_voice_call:true}'
        else
            jq -nc --arg v "$1" --arg r "$3" --argjson e "$4" '{status:"FAILED",consensus_outcome:"consensus",truncation_waiver_applied:false,voices_planned:1,voices_succeeded:0,voices_succeeded_ids:[],voices_dropped:[{voice:$v,reason:$r,exit_code:$e,blocker_risk:"unknown"}],chain_health:"exhausted",confidence_floor:"low",rationale:"stub",single_voice_call:true}'
        fi
    }
    export PYTHONPATH="$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/adapters"
}

s3_teardown() {
    pkill -KILL -f "loa-s3adv-slow-$$"'( |$)' 2>/dev/null || true
    [[ -n "${SPRINT:-}" && "$SPRINT" == "${S3_PREFIX:-x}"-* && -n "${PROJECT_ROOT:-}" ]] || return 0
    local d="$PROJECT_ROOT/grimoires/loa/a2a/$SPRINT"
    if [[ -d "$d" && ! -L "$d" ]]; then find "$d" -mindepth 1 -delete; rmdir "$d"; fi
    return 0
}

s3_config() {  # <yaml body> → the test's .loa.config.yaml (owner-only)
    printf '%s\n' "$1" > "$CONFIG_FILE"
}

s3_run() {  # <review|audit> → main's stdout (main runs in a subshell: it exits); stderr to $T/stderr.log; the status in $T/rc
    local rc=0
    ( main --type "${1:-review}" --sprint-id "$SPRINT" --diff-file "$T/diff.patch" --json ) 2> "$T/stderr.log" || rc=$?
    printf '%s' "$rc" > "$T/rc"
}

s3_norm() {  # <envelope file> → the envelope without advisory_voices, keys sorted, and only the clock-dependent fields removed
    # (the normalised compare: a timestamp and the repairs' measured wall seconds differ between any two runs, advisory or not)
    jq -S 'del(.advisory_voices) | walk(if type == "object" then del(.timestamp, .ts_utc, .repair_wall_seconds) else . end)' "$1"
}

    [ "$(jq '.findings | length' "$env")" = "2" ]
    [ "$(jq '[.findings[] | select(.voice == "advisory")] | length' "$env")" = "0" ]
    [ "$(jq '.verdict_quality.voices_planned' "$env")" = "2" ]
    # the block
    [ "$(jq '.advisory_voices | length' "$env")" = "1" ]
    [ "$(jq -r '.advisory_voices[0].alias' "$env")" = "adv-two" ]
    [ "$(jq -r '.advisory_voices[0].status' "$env")" = "succeeded" ]
    [ "$(jq -r '.advisory_voices[0].counted_as' "$env")" = "advisory_voice" ]
    [ "$(jq '.advisory_voices[0].findings | length' "$env")" = "3" ]
    [ "$(jq -r '[.advisory_voices[0].findings[].voice] | unique | join(",")' "$env")" = "advisory" ]
    [ "$(jq -r '[.advisory_voices[0].findings[].id] | join(",")' "$env")" = "DISS-A1-001,DISS-A1-002,DISS-A1-003" ]
    # same file, overlapping lines (9-12 over 10), same category → the counted primary finding; else null
    [ "$(jq -r '.advisory_voices[0].findings[0].duplicate_of' "$env")" = "DISS-001" ]
    [ "$(jq -r '.advisory_voices[0].findings[1].duplicate_of' "$env")" = "null" ]   # (line 40: no overlap)
    [ "$(jq -r '.advisory_voices[0].findings[2].duplicate_of' "$env")" = "null" ]   # (same line, another category)
    [ "$(jq -r '.advisory_voices[0].findings[0].answered_by' "$env")" = "adv-two" ]
    grep -qx "adv-two" "$CALLS"
    # stdout carries the same envelope
    [ "$(jq '.advisory_voices | length' <<<"$result")" = "1" ]
}

@test "ADV-2 the envelope without advisory_voices and the verdict-derive --json output are byte-identical with and without advisory voices" {
    _feedback
    BEHAVIOUR[adv-two]=two; BEHAVIOUR[adv-reject]=reject; BEHAVIOUR[adv-fail]=fail
    _base_cfg
    s3_run review >/dev/null
    [ "$(cat "$T/rc")" = "0" ] || { cat "$T/stderr.log"; return 1; }
    cp "$OUT_DIR/adversarial-review.json" "$T/without.json"
    _vd > "$T/vd-without.json"
    ls "$OUT_DIR" | LC_ALL=C sort > "$T/ls-without"
    _base_cfg "    advisory_voices: [adv-two, adv-reject, adv-fail]"
    s3_run review >/dev/null
    [ "$(cat "$T/rc")" = "0" ] || { cat "$T/stderr.log"; return 1; }
    cp "$OUT_DIR/adversarial-review.json" "$T/with.json"
    _vd > "$T/vd-with.json"
    ls "$OUT_DIR" | LC_ALL=C sort > "$T/ls-with"
    [ "$(jq '.advisory_voices | length' "$T/with.json")" = "3" ]
    jq -e 'has("advisory_voices") | not' "$T/without.json" >/dev/null
    # the normalised envelopes (advisory_voices deleted, timestamps removed, keys sorted) are byte-identical
    diff <(s3_norm "$T/without.json") <(s3_norm "$T/with.json")
    # …and each named input on its own, so a failure names it
    local k
    for k in '.findings' '.verdict_quality' '.verdict_quality.voices_planned' '.verdict_quality.voices_succeeded' \
             '.metadata.companion_voice' '.metadata.rejected_summary' '.metadata.rejected_sidecars' '.metadata.cost_usd'; do
        [ "$(jq -cS "$k" "$T/without.json")" = "$(jq -cS "$k" "$T/with.json")" ] || { echo "differs: $k"; return 1; }
    done
    # verdict-derive reads the same envelope and sidecars: its --json output is byte-identical
    [ -s "$T/vd-without.json" ]
    diff "$T/vd-without.json" "$T/vd-with.json"
    # the advisory voice's rejected payload never landed beside the envelope (verdict-derive would count it)
    diff "$T/ls-without" "$T/ls-with"
    [ "$(jq -r '.advisory_voices[] | select(.alias == "adv-reject") | .rejected_count' "$T/with.json")" = "1" ]
}

@test "ADV-3 a failed or malformed advisory voice is recorded under advisory_voices[].status and ignored by verdict quality" {
    BEHAVIOUR[adv-fail]=fail; BEHAVIOUR[adv-bad]=malformed
    _base_cfg "    advisory_voices: [adv-fail, adv-bad]"
    s3_run review >/dev/null
    [ "$(cat "$T/rc")" = "0" ] || { cat "$T/stderr.log"; return 1; }
    env="$OUT_DIR/adversarial-review.json"
    [ "$(jq -r '[.advisory_voices[].status] | join(",")' "$env")" = "failed,failed" ]
    [ "$(jq '[.advisory_voices[].findings | length] | add' "$env")" = "0" ]
    [ "$(jq -r '.verdict_quality.status' "$env")" = "APPROVED" ]
    [ "$(jq '.verdict_quality.voices_planned' "$env")" = "2" ]
    [ "$(jq '.verdict_quality.voices_succeeded' "$env")" = "2" ]
    [ "$(jq '[.verdict_quality.voices_dropped[]?.voice] | map(select(test("adv-"))) | length' "$env")" = "0" ]
}

@test "ADV-4 the advisory wall clock is honoured: a voice still running is killed and timed_out while a fast one completes" {
    BEHAVIOUR[adv-slow]=slow; BEHAVIOUR[adv-two]=two
    _base_cfg "    advisory_voices: [adv-slow, adv-two]
    advisory_timeout_seconds: 2"
    local t0 t1; t0=$(date +%s)
    s3_run review >/dev/null
    t1=$(date +%s)
    [ "$(cat "$T/rc")" = "0" ] || { cat "$T/stderr.log"; return 1; }
    (( t1 - t0 < 60 ))
    env="$OUT_DIR/adversarial-review.json"
    [ "$(jq -r '.advisory_voices[0].status' "$env")" = "timed_out" ]
    [ "$(jq -r '.advisory_voices[1].status' "$env")" = "succeeded" ]
    grep -q "Advisory voice adv-slow: still running at the 2s advisory wall clock — killed (timed_out)" "$T/stderr.log"
    # the hung hop did not outlive the run
    sleep 0.5
    ! pgrep -f "loa-s3adv-slow-$$" >/dev/null || { echo "the hung advisory hop outlived the run"; return 1; }
    [ "$(jq '.verdict_quality.voices_planned' "$env")" = "2" ]
}

@test "ADV-5 an advisory alias the block also counts in companion_chain is refused by name at plan time, before any call" {
    _base_cfg "    advisory_voices: [claude-headless]
    companion_chain:
      anthropic: [claude-headless]"

    [ "$(cat "$T/rc")" = "1" ]
    grep -qF "advisory voice claude-headless cannot be counted: no arms report line for the alias (voice arms are a future iteration)" "$T/stderr.log"
    grep -qF "hounfour.advisory_promotion: min_recall_ratio=0.8, max_refuted_delta=unset" "$T/stderr.log"
    [ "$(jq -r '.metadata.status' <<<"$result")" = "advisory_promotion_refused" ]
    [ "$(jq -r '.metadata.alias' <<<"$result")" = "claude-headless" ]
    [ ! -s "$CALLS" ]
    [ ! -e "$OUT_DIR/adversarial-review.json" ]
}

@test "ADV-6 with no advisory_voices the envelope has no advisory_voices key (the default is unchanged)" {

    s3_run review >/dev/null
    [ "$(cat "$T/rc")" = "0" ]

}

@test "ADV-7 a malformed advisory_voices value is said and ignored; a bad element is dropped by index" {
    _base_cfg "    advisory_voices: adv-two"
    s3_run review >/dev/null
    grep -q "advisory_voices is a str, not a list of aliases — ignored" "$T/stderr.log"

    BEHAVIOUR[adv-two]=two
    _base_cfg "    advisory_voices: [adv-two, {x: 1}, 'bad name']"

    grep -q "advisory_voices\[1\] is not a hop name (!!map) — dropped" "$T/stderr.log"

@test "ADV-9 the audit gate reads security_audit.advisory_voices: the block is on adversarial-audit.json, the tally inputs unchanged" {

def _local(**overrides: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    cfg = copy.deepcopy(_BY_NAME["local-openai-compatible"])
    prov = cfg["providers"]["local"]
    for k, v in overrides.items():
        if v is None:
            prov.pop(k, None)
        else:
            prov[k] = v
    return cfg


REFUSALS = [
    ("public-http-host", dict(endpoint="http://8.8.8.8/v1", allow_insecure_endpoint=None), "ENDPOINT-INSECURE-SCHEME"),
    ("public-http-dns", dict(endpoint="http://api.example.com/v1", allow_insecure_endpoint=None),
     "ENDPOINT-INSECURE-SCHEME"),
    ("boolean-optin", dict(allow_insecure_endpoint=True), "ENDPOINT-OPTIN-BOOLEAN"),

    ("https-private-without-optin", dict(endpoint="https://10.0.0.5/v1", allow_insecure_endpoint=None),

#!/usr/bin/env bats
# =============================================================================
# tests/unit/adversarial-review-locality.bats — cycle-129 Sprint 3 Task 3.5 (PRD FR-8 AC-8.1 … AC-8.3, SDD D-8.0 … D-8.2,
# DEC-0146).
#
# Under hounfour.locality: local_voices, adversarial-review.sh plans only hops whose provider has dispatch_group: local in
# the merged config (catalog + the project's hounfour.providers) and refuses every hosted hop of its inventory at plan time
# by name — primary chain, companion chain, advisory voices, the KF-004 repair chain (tiny, claude-headless, any pin; the
# chain is the answering voice). With one local family the audit is DEGRADED_SECURITY_REVIEW, the gate and verdict-derive
# treat the envelope as today, and the output says so. The default (hosted) is unchanged. Mock mode: the harness stub.
# =============================================================================

load adversarial-review-s3-helpers

setup() { export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR"; s3_setup sprint-s3loc; }   # (the CLI lock is this test's own — CMP-121)
teardown() { s3_teardown; }

# one hosted provider (openai, the catalog's) and one local provider (localbox, declared here)
_cfg() {  # <locality value | absent> [extra code_review / security_audit lines]
    local loc=""; [[ "$1" == absent ]] || loc="  locality: $1"
    s3_config "hounfour:
$loc
  providers:
    localbox:
      type: openai_compat
      endpoint: \"http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1\"
      models:
        qwen-local:
          dispatch_group: local
          pricing: {input_per_mtok: 0, output_per_mtok: 0}
        qwen-local-b:
          dispatch_group: local
          pricing: {input_per_mtok: 0, output_per_mtok: 0}
        qwen-local-c:
          dispatch_group: local
        qwen-leaky:
          dispatch_group: local
          fallback_chain: [\"openai:gpt-5.5\"]
  aliases:
    lq: \"localbox:qwen-local\"
    lqb: \"localbox:qwen-local-b\"
    lqc: \"localbox:qwen-local-c\"
flatline_protocol:
  code_review:
    enabled: true
    model: gpt-5.5
    budget_cents: 500
    timeout_seconds: 30
    fallback_chain: [lq]
${2:-}
  security_audit:
    enabled: true
    model: gpt-5.5
    budget_cents: 500
    timeout_seconds: 30
    fallback_chain: [lq]
${3:-}"
}

_hosted_in() {  # <file of hop names, one per line> → the hosted ones, as hop-locality.py classifies them against this config
    local hops; hops=$(sed 's/^repair://' "$1" | sort -u | grep -v '^$' || true)
    [[ -n "$hops" ]] || return 0
    # shellcheck disable=SC2086
    python3 -I "$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/lib/hop-locality.py" --catalog "$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/defaults/model-config.yaml" \
        --config "$CONFIG_FILE" -- $hops | awk -F'\t' '$3 != "local" { print $1 }'
}

@test "LOC-1 one hosted and one local provider: only the local hop is planned and every hosted hop is refused by name" {
    _cfg local_voices
    result=$(s3_run review)
    [ "$(cat "$T/rc")" = "0" ] || { cat "$T/stderr.log"; return 1; }
    env="$OUT_DIR/adversarial-review.json"
    # the dispatched hops: the local one only
    [ "$(sort -u "$CALLS" | tr '\n' ' ')" = "lq " ]
    [ "$(jq -r '.metadata.final_model' "$env")" = "lq" ]
    [ "$(jq -r '.metadata.model_attempts | join(",")' "$env")" = "lq:reviewed" ]
    # each refusal named: the hosted primary, the companion's default hop, the repair chain's two hosted hops
    grep -qxF "[adversarial-review] locality: local_voices refuses hosted hop gpt-5.5 (openai)" "$T/stderr.log"
    grep -qxF "[adversarial-review] locality: local_voices refuses hosted hop claude-headless (anthropic)" "$T/stderr.log"
    grep -qxF "[adversarial-review] locality: local_voices refuses hosted hop tiny (anthropic)" "$T/stderr.log"

# =============================================================================
# tests/unit/adversarial-review-locality.bats — cycle-129 Sprint 3 Task 3.5 (PRD FR-8 AC-8.1 … AC-8.3, SDD D-8.0 … D-8.2,
# DEC-0146).
#
# Under hounfour.locality: local_voices, adversarial-review.sh plans only hops whose provider has dispatch_group: local in
# the merged config (catalog + the project's hounfour.providers) and refuses every hosted hop of its inventory at plan time
# by name — primary chain, companion chain, advisory voices, the KF-004 repair chain (tiny, claude-headless, any pin; the
# chain is the answering voice). With one local family the audit is DEGRADED_SECURITY_REVIEW, the gate and verdict-derive
# treat the envelope as today, and the output says so. The default (hosted) is unchanged. Mock mode: the harness stub.

load adversarial-review-s3-helpers

setup() { export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="$BATS_TEST_TMPDIR"; s3_setup sprint-s3loc; }   # (the CLI lock is this test's own — CMP-121)
teardown() { s3_teardown; }

# one hosted provider (openai, the catalog's) and one local provider (localbox, declared here)

    local loc=""; [[ "$1" == absent ]] || loc="  locality: $1"
    s3_config "hounfour:
$loc
  providers:
    localbox:
      type: openai_compat
      endpoint: \"http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1\"
      models:
        qwen-local:
          dispatch_group: local
          pricing: {input_per_mtok: 0, output_per_mtok: 0}
        qwen-local-b:
          dispatch_group: local
          pricing: {input_per_mtok: 0, output_per_mtok: 0}
        qwen-local-c:
          dispatch_group: local
        qwen-leaky:
          dispatch_group: local
          fallback_chain: [\"openai:gpt-5.5\"]
  aliases:
    lq: \"localbox:qwen-local\"
    lqb: \"localbox:qwen-local-b\"
    lqc: \"localbox:qwen-local-c\"
flatline_protocol:
  code_review:
    enabled: true
    model: gpt-5.5
    budget_cents: 500
    timeout_seconds: 30
    fallback_chain: [lq]
${2:-}
  security_audit:
    enabled: true
    model: gpt-5.5
    budget_cents: 500
    timeout_seconds: 30
    fallback_chain: [lq]
${3:-}"
}

    local hops; hops=$(sed 's/^repair://' "$1" | sort -u | grep -v '^$' || true)

    python3 -I "$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/scripts/lib/hop-locality.py" --catalog "$PROJECT_ROOT/.claude/defaults/model-config.yaml" \
        --config "$CONFIG_FILE" -- $hops | awk -F'\t' '$3 != "local" { print $1 }'
}

+
+# Delta keys local OpenAI-compatible servers use for a reasoning trace (vLLM and
+# llama.cpp `reasoning_content`; some servers `reasoning`). Progress, never content.
+REASONING_DELTA_KEYS = ("reasoning_content", "reasoning")
+
+_LEADING_THINK_BLOCK = re.compile(r"\A\s*<think>(.*?)</think>\s*", re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL)
+_LEADING_THINK_OPEN = re.compile(r"\A\s*<think>", re.IGNORECASE)
+
+
+def strip_thinking_blocks(content: str) -> Tuple[str, str, bool]:
+    """Remove the reasoning a model prefixed to its answer: every leading
+    `<think>…</think>` block, and an unterminated leading `<think>` (the rest of the
+    content is then reasoning). Returns (content, removed_thinking, stripped).
+
+    Only LEADING blocks are removed: a `<think>` string inside the answer itself
+    (a finding that quotes a template, say) is content and stays."""
+    if not content:
+        return content, "", False
+    removed: List[str] = []
+    rest = content
+    while True:
+        m = _LEADING_THINK_BLOCK.match(rest)
+        if not m:
+            break
+        removed.append(m.group(1).strip())
+        rest = rest[m.end():]
+    if _LEADING_THINK_OPEN.match(rest):
+        removed.append(_LEADING_THINK_OPEN.sub("", rest, count=1).strip())
+        rest = ""
+    if not removed:
+        return content, "", False
+    return rest, "\n".join(p for p in removed if p), True
+
+
+def apply_thinking_strip(result: CompletionResult, reasoning_seen: bool = False) -> CompletionResult:
+    """Strip leading `<think>` blocks from `result.content` into `result.thinking`
+    and record `metadata["thinking_stripped"]` (true when a block was removed or a
+    reasoning trace arrived on its own channel). Applied before qualification on
+    the streaming and non-streaming OpenAI paths."""
+    content, removed, stripped = strip_thinking_blocks(result.content or "")
+    meta = dict(result.metadata or {})
+    meta["thinking_stripped"] = bool(stripped or reasoning_seen or meta.get("thinking_stripped"))
+    thinking = result.thinking
+    if removed:
+        thinking = f"{thinking}\n{removed}" if thinking else removed
+    result.content = content
+    result.thinking = thinking
+    result.metadata = meta
+    return result

write_timeout: 30                   # seconds

# Hounfour Examples:
#
# Each example sits between a `# @example-begin <name>` and a `# @example-end`
# marker. .claude/adapters/tests/test_config_examples_load.py uncomments every
# marked block, merges it over the System defaults with the real cheval loader
# and asserts it loads, so an example that would not load fails CI.
#
# Example 1: Conservative (all native, no remote calls)
# The Claude Code session itself still runs against Anthropic.
# @example-begin conservative
# hounfour:
#   flatline_routing: false
#   agents:
#     reviewing-code:
#       model: native
#     flatline-reviewer:
#       model: native
# @example-end
#
# Example 2: Budget-conscious (lower daily limit, aggressive downgrade)
# @example-begin budget-conscious
# hounfour:
#   metering:
#     budget:
#       daily_micro_usd: 50000000       # $50/day
#       warn_at_percent: 60
#       on_exceeded: block              # Hard stop instead of downgrade
# @example-end
#
# Example 3: Custom provider (e.g., Azure OpenAI)
# Every model of a custom HTTP provider declares endpoint_family, auth_type,
# dispatch_group and context_window. The key is read from an environment
# variable, which must match a secret_env_allowlist pattern: only LOA_*,
# OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, MOONSHOT_API_KEY, GOOGLE_API_KEY and
# GEMINI_API_KEY are allowed by default.
# @example-begin azure-openai
# hounfour:
#   secret_env_allowlist:
#     - "^AZURE_OPENAI_KEY$"
#   providers:
#     azure-openai:
#       type: openai
#       endpoint: "https://myorg.openai.azure.com/openai/deployments/gpt-5"
#       auth: "{env:AZURE_OPENAI_KEY}"
#       models:
#         gpt-5-azure:
#           endpoint_family: chat
#           auth_type: http_api
#           dispatch_group: azure
#           capabilities: [chat, tools, function_calling]
#           context_window: 400000
#           max_output_tokens: 16000
#           pricing:
#             input_per_mtok: 10000000
#             output_per_mtok: 30000000
#   aliases:
#     reviewer: "azure-openai:gpt-5-azure"
# @example-end
#
# Example 4: Local OpenAI-compatible server (vLLM, llama.cpp, Ollama, LM Studio)
# Threat model: plain http is admitted only to the one host named in
# allow_insecure_endpoint, an IP literal or localhost in a loopback or RFC1918
# range that is never resolved through DNS, so the prompt does not cross a
# public network unencrypted and the name cannot be rebound. For this provider
# cheval ignores proxy environment variables, refuses redirects and keeps every
# request under the declared endpoint path, while every other provider keeps the
# https, loopback and private-range refusals.
# keyless: true sends no credential (a literal auth: "local" means the same).
# secret_env_allowlist: if your server does want a key, use
# auth: "{env:LOCAL_LLM_KEY}" instead of keyless and add "^LOCAL_LLM_KEY$" to
# secret_env_allowlist; an environment variable outside the allowlist is refused.
# A prompt over the declared context_window refuses the hop by name and is never
# truncated; the zero prices record the hop at cost 0.
# @example-begin local-openai-compatible
# hounfour:
#   providers:
#     local:
#       type: openai_compat
#       endpoint: "http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1"
#       keyless: true
#       allow_insecure_endpoint: "127.0.0.1"   # a host string, never a boolean
#       models:
#         qwen3-coder-30b:
#           endpoint_family: chat
#           auth_type: http_api
#           dispatch_group: local                # marks the hop local (hop_locality: local)
#           capabilities: [chat]                 # add structured_json if the server enforces response_format
#           context_window: 32768
#           max_output_tokens: 8192
#           streaming_recovery:
#             first_token_deadline_s: 120        # CPU servers take a while on a large prompt
#           pricing:
#             input_per_mtok: 0
#             output_per_mtok: 0
#   aliases:
#     local-reviewer: "local:qwen3-coder-30b"
# @example-end

  # callers treat 3 as "completed, degraded" and print a WARN naming the voices. 0 restores the pre-cycle-129

    local body_file="${5:-}"

    local insecure_host="${6:-}"

        HTTP_STATUS="${LOA_PROBE_MOCK_HTTP_STATUS:-200}"
        local fixture=""
        case "$url" in
            *openai.com*)     fixture="${LOA_PROBE_MOCK_OPENAI:-}" ;;
            *googleapis.com*) fixture="${LOA_PROBE_MOCK_GOOGLE:-}" ;;
            *anthropic.com*)  fixture="${LOA_PROBE_MOCK_ANTHROPIC:-}" ;;
            *)                fixture="${LOA_PROBE_MOCK_CONFIGURED:-}" ;;
        esac
        if [[ -n "$fixture" && -f "$fixture" ]]; then
            RESPONSE_BODY="$(cat "$fixture")"
        else

    # shell-compat-lint allowlist matches (raw curl auth is a lint error; the
    # secure helper pattern is allowlisted).

        return 1
    fi

    local cfg

            ;;
        x-api-key)
            cfg=$(write_curl_auth_config "x-api-key" "$api_key") || return 1
            # Anthropic /v1/messages requires anthropic-version on every call.
            # Audit L-1 / Bridgebuilder iter-3 BLOCKING fix; tempfile is 0600.
            printf 'header = "anthropic-version: 2023-06-01"\n' >> "$cfg"
            ;;

            cfg=$(write_curl_auth_config "x-goog-api-key" "$api_key") || return 1
            ;;
        none)

            cfg=""
            ;;
        *)

    out_body=$(mktemp)
    local curl_rc=0
    local status_line=""
    # cycle-099 sprint-1E.c.3.a: every provider HTTP call funnels through

    # passed via --config-auth (NOT --config) so the wrapper inspects it for

    fi

            "${_wrap[@]}" \

            "${_wrap[@]}" \
            --url "$url" \

def interpolate_config(
    config: Dict[str, Any],
    project_root: str,
    extra_env_patterns: List[re.Pattern] = (),
    allowed_file_dirs: List[str] = (),
    commands_enabled: bool = False,
    _secret_keys: Optional[Set[str]] = None,
    lazy_paths: Optional[Set[str]] = None,
    _current_path: str = "",
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    """Recursively interpolate all string values in a config dict.

    Returns a new dict with resolved values.
    Tracks which keys contained secrets for redaction.

    Args:
        lazy_paths: Set of dotted key patterns where interpolation is deferred.
            Defaults to _DEFAULT_LAZY_PATHS (providers.*.auth).
            Pass empty set() to disable lazy behavior entirely.
    """
    if _secret_keys is None:
        _secret_keys = set()
    if lazy_paths is None:
        lazy_paths = _DEFAULT_LAZY_PATHS

    result = {}
    for key, value in config.items():
        full_path = f"{_current_path}.{key}" if _current_path else key

        if isinstance(value, str) and _INTERP_RE.search(value):
            _secret_keys.add(key)
            if lazy_paths and _matches_lazy_path(full_path, lazy_paths):
                # Defer resolution — wrap in LazyValue
                # Extract provider name from path for error context
                parts = full_path.split(".")
                provider_name = parts[1] if len(parts) >= 2 else "unknown"
                result[key] = LazyValue(
                    raw=value,
                    project_root=project_root,
                    extra_env_patterns=extra_env_patterns,
                    allowed_file_dirs=allowed_file_dirs,
                    commands_enabled=commands_enabled,
                    context={"provider": provider_name},
                )
            else:
                result[key] = interpolate_value(value, project_root, extra_env_patterns, allowed_file_dirs, commands_enabled)
        elif isinstance(value, dict):
            result[key] = interpolate_config(
                value, project_root, extra_env_patterns, allowed_file_dirs,
                commands_enabled, _secret_keys, lazy_paths, full_path,
            )
        elif isinstance(value, list):
            result[key] = [
                interpolate_config(
                    item, project_root, extra_env_patterns, allowed_file_dirs,
                    commands_enabled, _secret_keys, lazy_paths, full_path,
                )
                if isinstance(item, dict)
                else interpolate_value(item, project_root, extra_env_patterns, allowed_file_dirs, commands_enabled)
                if isinstance(item, str) and _INTERP_RE.search(item)
                else item
                for item in value
            ]
        else:
            result[key] = value
    return result

+"""cycle-129 FR-7 (SDD D-7.2; sprint-257 Task 3.1, AC-3.1) — the per-provider
+insecure-endpoint opt-in on BOTH paths, and the request-time rules.
+
+* One case table runs through the bash-path validator
+  (`.claude/scripts/lib/endpoint-validator.py` `validate(..., allow_insecure_endpoint=...)`)
+  and the cheval Python path (`loa_cheval.config.endpoint_policy.check_endpoint`); the two
+  must agree on accept/refuse and on the refusal code.
+* D-7.2 test list: IPv4 and IPv6 loopback accepted, RFC1918 accepted, link-local and metadata
+  refused, DNS name refused, boolean refused, cross-provider isolation, and — at request time
+  against a stub server bound to 127.0.0.1 — redirect refused, proxy env ignored, path prefix
+  enforced, on the httpx and the urllib transport.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import importlib.util
+import json
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import threading
+from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer
+from pathlib import Path

+ALLOWLIST_PATH = REPO_ROOT / ".claude" / "scripts" / "lib" / "allowlists" / "loa-providers.json"

+
+def _load_validator():

+    mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    assert spec.loader is not None
+    sys.modules[spec.name] = mod
+    spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
+    return mod
+
+
+EV = _load_validator()
+ALLOWLIST = EV.load_allowlist(ALLOWLIST_PATH)
+
+OK = None
+# (case id, url, allow_insecure_endpoint, expected refusal code or OK)
+CASES = [
+    ("ipv4-loopback", "http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1", "127.0.0.1", OK),
+    ("ipv4-loopback-other-127", "http://127.0.0.2:8000/v1", "127.0.0.2", OK),
+    ("ipv6-loopback", "http://[::1]:8000/v1", "::1", OK),
+    ("ipv6-loopback-bracketed-optin", "http://[::1]:8000/v1", "[::1]", OK),

+    ("metadata-v4", "http://169.254.169.254/latest", "169.254.169.254", "ENDPOINT-OPTIN-METADATA"),
+    ("metadata-v6", "http://[fd00:ec2::254]/latest", "fd00:ec2::254", "ENDPOINT-OPTIN-METADATA"),
+    ("dns-name", "http://llm.lan:8000/v1", "llm.lan", "ENDPOINT-OPTIN-DNS-NAME"),
+    ("public-v4", "http://8.8.8.8/v1", "8.8.8.8", "ENDPOINT-OPTIN-NOT-LOCAL"),

+    ("cgnat-not-rfc1918", "http://100.64.0.1/v1", "100.64.0.1", "ENDPOINT-OPTIN-NOT-LOCAL"),

+    ("mismatched-public", "http://8.8.8.8/v1", "127.0.0.1", "ENDPOINT-INSECURE-HOST-MISMATCH"),
+    ("http-no-optin-loopback", "http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1", None, "ENDPOINT-INSECURE-SCHEME"),
+    ("http-no-optin-public", "http://8.8.8.8/v1", None, "ENDPOINT-INSECURE-SCHEME"),
+    ("https-no-optin-loopback", "https://127.0.0.1/v1", None, "ENDPOINT-IP-BLOCKED"),
+    ("https-no-optin-rfc1918", "https://10.0.0.1/v1", None, "ENDPOINT-IP-BLOCKED"),
+    ("https-no-optin-metadata", "https://169.254.169.254/", None, "ENDPOINT-IP-BLOCKED"),
+    ("https-no-optin-v6-loopback", "https://[::1]/v1", None, "ENDPOINT-IPV6-BLOCKED"),
+    ("userinfo-on-optin-host", "http://user:pw@127.0.0.1:8000/v1", "127.0.0.1", "ENDPOINT-USERINFO-PRESENT"),
+]
+

+def _cheval(url: str, optin: Any) -> Optional[str]:
+    try:
+        check_endpoint(url, optin, "p")
+    except EndpointPolicyError as exc:
+        return exc.policy_code
+    return OK
+
+
+def _bash_path(url: str, optin: Any) -> Optional[str]:
+    result = EV.validate(url, ALLOWLIST, allow_insecure_endpoint=optin)
+    return OK if result.valid else result.code
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("case, url, optin, expected", CASES, ids=[c[0] for c in CASES])
+def test_both_paths_agree(case, url, optin, expected):
+    assert _cheval(url, optin) == expected, f"cheval path: {case}"
+    assert _bash_path(url, optin) == expected, f"endpoint-validator.py: {case}"
+
+
+def test_validator_cli_flag_admits_only_the_optin_host():
+    def run(*args: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess:
+        return subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", str(VALIDATOR_PATH), "--allowlist", str(ALLOWLIST_PATH), *args],
+                              capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
+
+    ok = run("--allow-insecure-endpoint", "127.0.0.1", "--json", "http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/models")
+    assert ok.returncode == 0, ok.stderr
+    assert json.loads(ok.stdout)["extra"] == {"insecure_optin": "127.0.0.1"}
+    refused = run("--allow-insecure-endpoint", "true", "http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/models")
+    assert refused.returncode == 78 and "ENDPOINT-OPTIN-DNS-NAME" in refused.stderr
+    no_optin = run("http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/models")
+    assert no_optin.returncode == 78 and "ENDPOINT-INSECURE-SCHEME" in no_optin.stderr
+
+
+def test_cross_provider_isolation_on_both_paths():
+    """Provider A's opt-in is passed with A's URL only; provider B (same loopback host, no
+    opt-in of its own) keeps every refusal on both paths, before and after A is validated."""
+    a_url, a_optin = "http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1", "127.0.0.1"
+    b_url = "http://127.0.0.1:9000/v1"
+    for _ in range(2):
+        assert _cheval(a_url, a_optin) is OK and _bash_path(a_url, a_optin) is OK
+        assert _cheval(b_url, None) == "ENDPOINT-INSECURE-SCHEME"
+        assert _bash_path(b_url, None) == "ENDPOINT-INSECURE-SCHEME"
+    # the hosted provider's https URL is untouched by A's opt-in
+    assert _bash_path("https://api.openai.com/v1", None) is OK
+    assert _bash_path("https://api.openai.com/v1", a_optin) is OK
+
+
+# --- request time: a stub server on 127.0.0.1 -------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+class _Stub:
+    """127.0.0.1 HTTP server the test starts and stops. Paths: /v1/ok (200 JSON),
+    /v1/redirect (302 to /v1/ok), /v1/stream (one SSE chunk). Records request headers."""
+
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        stub = self
+        self.seen: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
+
+        class H(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
+            def _reply(self) -> None:
+                length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0)
+                if length:
+                    self.rfile.read(length)
+                stub.seen.append({"path": self.path, "headers": dict(self.headers)})
+                if self.path.endswith("/redirect"):
+                    self.send_response(302)
+                    self.send_header("Location", f"http://127.0.0.1:{stub.port}/v1/ok")
+                    self.send_header("Content-Length", "0")
+                    self.end_headers()
+                    return
+                payload = b'{"ok": true}'
+                self.send_response(200)
+                self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
+                self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(payload)))
+                self.end_headers()
+                self.wfile.write(payload)
+
+            do_GET = _reply
+            do_POST = _reply
+
+            def log_message(self, *args: Any) -> None:
+                pass
+
+        self.server = HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), H)
+        self.port = self.server.server_port
+        self.thread = threading.Thread(target=self.server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
+
+    def __enter__(self) -> "_Stub":
+        self.thread.start()
+        return self
+
+    def __exit__(self, *exc: Any) -> None:
+        self.server.shutdown()
+        self.server.server_close()
+
+    @property
+    def endpoint(self) -> str:
+        return f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.port}/v1"
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(params=["httpx", "urllib"])
+def transport(request, monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(base, "_HTTP_CLIENT", request.param)
+    yield request.param
+    base._reset_http_client_detection_for_tests()
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def stub():
+    with _Stub() as s:
+        yield s
+
+
+def _policy(s: _Stub) -> TransportPolicy:
+    return TransportPolicy(endpoint=s.endpoint, provider="local")
+
+
+def test_redirect_refused(transport, stub):
+    with pytest.raises(InvalidConfigError, match="redirect refused"):
+        http_post(f"{stub.endpoint}/redirect", {}, {"x": 1}, policy=_policy(stub))
+    with pytest.raises(InvalidConfigError, match="redirect refused"):
+        http_get(f"{stub.endpoint}/redirect", {}, policy=_policy(stub))
+    with pytest.raises(InvalidConfigError, match="redirect refused"):
+        with http_post_stream(f"{stub.endpoint}/redirect", {}, {"x": 1}, policy=_policy(stub)):
+            pass
+    # never followed: the stub saw only the redirecting request, never /v1/ok
+    assert all(r["path"].endswith("/redirect") for r in stub.seen)
+
+
+_PROXY_VARS = ("HTTP_PROXY", "HTTPS_PROXY", "ALL_PROXY", "http_proxy", "https_proxy", "all_proxy")
+
+
+def test_proxy_env_ignored(transport, stub, monkeypatch):
+    import urllib.request
+
+    for var in ("NO_PROXY", "no_proxy"):
+        monkeypatch.delenv(var, raising=False)
+    for var in _PROXY_VARS:
+        monkeypatch.setenv(var, "http://127.0.0.1:1")   # a dead proxy: any use of it fails
+    # urllib caches a process-wide default opener whose ProxyHandler read the env when it
+    # was built; drop it so the no-policy control below sees this test's proxy env.
+    monkeypatch.setattr(urllib.request, "_opener", None)
+    status, body = http_post(f"{stub.endpoint}/ok", {}, {"x": 1}, policy=_policy(stub))
+    assert (status, body) == (200, {"ok": True})
+    status, _ = http_get(f"{stub.endpoint}/ok", {}, policy=_policy(stub))
+    assert status == 200
+    with http_post_stream(f"{stub.endpoint}/ok", {}, {"x": 1}, policy=_policy(stub)) as resp:
+        assert resp.status_code == 200 and b"".join(resp.iter_bytes()) == b'{"ok": true}'
+    # control: without the policy the same call goes to the dead proxy and never reaches the stub
+    seen_before = len(stub.seen)
+    try:
+        control_status: Optional[int] = http_post(f"{stub.endpoint}/ok", {}, {"x": 1})[0]
+    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 — httpx raises ConnectionLostError; urllib returns 503
+        control_status = None

+    assert len(stub.seen) == seen_before
+

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("url", [
+    "/other/chat/completions",          # outside the declared path
+    "/v10/chat/completions",            # a sibling that only shares the prefix string

+    monkeypatch.setenv("LOA_CHEVAL_DISABLE_STREAMING", "1")
+    cfg = ProviderConfig(
+        name="local", type="openai_compat", endpoint=stub.endpoint, auth="",
+        keyless=True, allow_insecure_endpoint="127.0.0.1",
+        models={"m": ModelConfig(capabilities=["chat"], context_window=32768, endpoint_family="chat",
+                                 dispatch_group="local")},
+    )
+    adapter = OpenAIAdapter(cfg)
+    assert adapter.validate_config() == []
+    # the stub answers {"ok": true}: no `choices`, so the parse fails AFTER the request
+    with pytest.raises(Exception, match="no choices"):
+        adapter.complete(CompletionRequest(messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "hi"}], model="m", max_tokens=16))

+from loa_cheval.types import CompletionRequest, InvalidInputError, ModelConfig, ProviderConfig  # noqa: E402
+
+SCHEMA = {"type": "object", "properties": {"findings": {"type": "array"}}, "required": ["findings"],
+          "additionalProperties": False}
+
+
+def _cfg(caps: List[str]) -> ProviderConfig:
+    return ProviderConfig(
+        name="local", type="openai_compat", endpoint="http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1", auth="", keyless=True,
+        allow_insecure_endpoint="127.0.0.1",
+        models={"m": ModelConfig(capabilities=caps, context_window=32768, endpoint_family="chat",
+                                 dispatch_group="local")},
+    )
+
+
+def _req(schema: Any = SCHEMA) -> CompletionRequest:
+    meta = {"output_schema_name": "adversarial-finding.wire.json"} if schema is not None else {}
+    return CompletionRequest(messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "review"}], model="m", max_tokens=64,
+                             output_schema=schema, metadata=meta)
+
+
+# --- body ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def test_chat_body_carries_response_format_for_a_structured_json_entry():
+    adapter = OpenAIAdapter(_cfg(["chat", "structured_json"]))
+    body = adapter._build_chat_body(_req(), adapter._get_model_config("m"))
+    assert body["response_format"] == {
+        "type": "json_schema",
+        "json_schema": {"name": "adversarial-finding", "schema": SCHEMA, "strict": True},
+    }
+    assert oa._schema_enforced(body) is True
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("caps, schema", [(["chat"], SCHEMA), (["chat", "structured_json"], None)],
+                         ids=["no-structured_json-capability", "no-schema-requested"])
+def test_chat_body_has_no_response_format_otherwise(caps, schema):
+    adapter = OpenAIAdapter(_cfg(caps))
+    body = adapter._build_chat_body(_req(schema), adapter._get_model_config("m"))
+    assert "response_format" not in body
+    assert oa._schema_enforced(body) is False
+
+
+# --- schema_enforced truth through complete() -----------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def _ok_chat() -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    return {"choices": [{"message": {"content": '{"findings": []}'}}], "model": "m",
+            "usage": {"prompt_tokens": 3, "completion_tokens": 4}}
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("caps, expected", [(["chat", "structured_json"], True), (["chat"], False)])
+def test_schema_enforced_is_true_only_when_the_body_carried_it(monkeypatch, caps, expected):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("LOA_CHEVAL_DISABLE_STREAMING", "1")
+    sent: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
+
+    def fake_post(url, headers, body, connect_timeout=10.0, read_timeout=120.0, policy=None):
+        sent.append(body)
+        return 200, _ok_chat()
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(oa, "http_post", fake_post)
+    result = OpenAIAdapter(_cfg(caps)).complete(_req())
+    assert ("response_format" in sent[0]) is expected
+    assert result.metadata["schema_enforced"] is expected
+    assert "schema_rejected_by_server" not in result.metadata
+
+
+# --- the 400 retry ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+_REJECTIONS = [
+    {"error": {"message": "response_format json_schema is not supported by this server", "type": "BadRequestError"}},
+    {"object": "error", "message": "Unknown field: json_schema", "code": 400},
+    {"detail": [{"loc": ["body", "response_format"], "msg": "extra fields not permitted"}]},
+]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("rejection", _REJECTIONS, ids=["openai-shape", "vllm-shape", "fastapi-shape"])
+def test_non_streaming_400_naming_response_format_retries_once_without_it(monkeypatch, rejection):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("LOA_CHEVAL_DISABLE_STREAMING", "1")
+    sent: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
+    replies = [(400, rejection), (200, _ok_chat())]
+
+    def fake_post(url, headers, body, connect_timeout=10.0, read_timeout=120.0, policy=None):
+        sent.append(dict(body))
+        return replies.pop(0)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(oa, "http_post", fake_post)
+    result = OpenAIAdapter(_cfg(["chat", "structured_json"])).complete(_req())
+    assert len(sent) == 2
+    assert "response_format" in sent[0] and "response_format" not in sent[1]
+    assert result.metadata["schema_enforced"] is False
+    assert result.metadata["schema_rejected_by_server"] is True
+    assert result.content == '{"findings": []}'
+
+
+def test_a_400_not_naming_response_format_is_not_retried(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("LOA_CHEVAL_DISABLE_STREAMING", "1")
+    sent: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
+
+    def fake_post(url, headers, body, connect_timeout=10.0, read_timeout=120.0, policy=None):
+        sent.append(body)
+        return 400, {"error": {"message": "max_tokens is too large"}}
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(oa, "http_post", fake_post)
+    with pytest.raises(InvalidInputError, match="max_tokens is too large"):
+        OpenAIAdapter(_cfg(["chat", "structured_json"])).complete(_req())
+    assert len(sent) == 1
+
+
+def test_a_second_rejection_is_not_retried_again(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("LOA_CHEVAL_DISABLE_STREAMING", "1")
+    sent: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
+
+    def fake_post(url, headers, body, connect_timeout=10.0, read_timeout=120.0, policy=None):
+        sent.append(body)
+        return 400, {"error": {"message": "response_format unsupported"}}
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(oa, "http_post", fake_post)
+    with pytest.raises(InvalidInputError):
+        OpenAIAdapter(_cfg(["chat", "structured_json"])).complete(_req())
+    assert len(sent) == 2   # the original and exactly one retry without the schema
+
+
+class _FakeStream:
+    def __init__(self, status: int, chunks: List[bytes]):
+        self.status_code = status
+        self._chunks = chunks
+
+    def iter_bytes(self):
+        return iter(self._chunks)
+
+
+def test_streaming_400_naming_response_format_retries_once_without_it(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.delenv("LOA_CHEVAL_DISABLE_STREAMING", raising=False)
+    sent: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
+    ok_sse = [
+        b'data: {"choices":[{"delta":{"content":"{\\"findings\\": []}"},"finish_reason":null}],"model":"m"}\n\n',
+        b'data: {"choices":[{"delta":{},"finish_reason":"stop"}],"model":"m"}\n\n',
+        b"data: [DONE]\n\n",
+    ]
+    replies = [_FakeStream(400, [b'{"error":{"message":"response_format is not supported"}}']),
+               _FakeStream(200, ok_sse)]
+
+    @contextmanager
+    def fake_stream(url, headers, body, connect_timeout=10.0, read_timeout=120.0, policy=None):
+        sent.append(dict(body))
+        yield replies.pop(0)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(oa, "http_post_stream", fake_stream)
+    result = OpenAIAdapter(_cfg(["chat", "structured_json"])).complete(_req())
+    assert len(sent) == 2
+    assert "response_format" in sent[0] and "response_format" not in sent[1]
+    assert result.metadata["schema_enforced"] is False
+    assert result.metadata["schema_rejected_by_server"] is True
+    assert result.content == '{"findings": []}'
+
+
+def test_the_heuristic():
+    assert oa._names_response_format(400, {"error": {"message": "bad RESPONSE_FORMAT"}})
+    assert oa._names_response_format(400, "json_schema: unsupported")
+    assert not oa._names_response_format(422, {"error": {"message": "response_format"}})
+    assert not oa._names_response_format(400, {"error": {"message": "context length exceeded"}})

+"""cycle-129 FR-7 / FR-8 (SDD D-7.2, D-7.3, D-8.0; sprint-257 Task 3.2, AC-3.2) — a local
+OpenAI-compatible hop end to end through `cheval.cmd_invoke`, the real loader and the real
+OpenAI adapter, against a stub server the test binds to 127.0.0.1 and stops.
+
+* The stub streams `reasoning_content` deltas, then a `<think>`-prefixed answer: the
+  answer printed is the JSON alone, and the MODELINV row records `thinking_stripped`,
+  `schema_enforced` (response_format carried for a `structured_json` entry),
+  `destination: {host, scheme, provider}`, `locality_mode` and `hop_locality: local`.
+* A stub that rejects `response_format` with HTTP 400: one retry without it,
+  `schema_enforced: false`, `schema_rejected_by_server: true`.
+* A prompt over the declared `context_window` refuses the hop with
+  `context_window exceeded (<n> > <limit>) for <alias>`, writes a MODELINV row with
+  `failure_class: context_window_refused`, and sends nothing to the server.
+* A hosted hop records `hop_locality: hosted` and its https destination.
+
+Every MODELINV payload captured here is validated against the shipped payload schema.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import copy
+import json
+import shutil
+import sys
+import threading
+import types
+from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import jsonschema
+import pytest
+import yaml
+
+sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))
+
+import cheval  # type: ignore[import-not-found]  # noqa: E402
+from loa_cheval.config.loader import clear_config_cache, load_config  # noqa: E402
+
+REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
+DEFAULTS = REPO_ROOT / ".claude" / "defaults" / "model-config.yaml"
+PAYLOAD_SCHEMA = (REPO_ROOT / ".claude" / "data" / "trajectory-schemas" / "model-events"
+                  / "model-invoke-complete.payload.schema.json")
+WIRE_SCHEMA = {"type": "object", "properties": {"findings": {"type": "array"}}, "required": ["findings"]}
+
+
+def _payload_validator() -> jsonschema.Draft202012Validator:
+    schema = json.loads(PAYLOAD_SCHEMA.read_text())
+    # the error_class enum lives in a sibling schema behind a loa:// $ref; a string suffices here
+    schema["properties"]["models_failed"]["items"]["properties"]["error_class"] = {"type": "string"}
+    return jsonschema.Draft202012Validator(schema)
+
+
+VALIDATOR = _payload_validator()
+
+
+# --- the stub server -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+class _Stub:
+    def __init__(self, mode: str = "stream-think") -> None:
+        stub = self
+        self.mode = mode
+        self.requests: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
+
+        class H(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
+            protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"
+
+            def do_POST(self) -> None:  # noqa: N802
+                length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0)
+                body = json.loads(self.rfile.read(length) or b"{}")
+                stub.requests.append({"path": self.path, "headers": dict(self.headers), "body": body})
+                if stub.mode == "reject-schema" and "response_format" in body:
+                    payload = json.dumps({"object": "error", "message": "response_format json_schema unsupported",
+                                          "code": 400}).encode()
+                    self.send_response(400)
+                    self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
+                    self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(payload)))
+                    self.end_headers()
+                    self.wfile.write(payload)
+                    return
+                events = [
+                    {"choices": [{"delta": {"role": "assistant", "reasoning_content": "Reading the diff. "}}]},
+                    {"choices": [{"delta": {"reasoning_content": "Nothing is wrong."}}]},
+                    {"choices": [{"delta": {"content": "<think>double-check</think>"}}]},
+                    {"choices": [{"delta": {"content": '{"findings": []}'}}]},
+                    {"choices": [{"delta": {}, "finish_reason": "stop"}]},
+                    {"choices": [], "usage": {"prompt_tokens": 12, "completion_tokens": 7}},
+                ]
+                raw = b"".join(f"data: {json.dumps(dict(e, model='qwen3-coder-30b'))}\n\n".encode() for e in events)
+                raw += b"data: [DONE]\n\n"
+                self.send_response(200)
+                self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/event-stream")
+                self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(raw)))
+                self.end_headers()
+                self.wfile.write(raw)
+
+            def log_message(self, *args: Any) -> None:
+                pass
+
+        self.server = HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), H)
+        self.port = self.server.server_port
+        self.thread = threading.Thread(target=self.server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
+        self.thread.start()
+
+    def stop(self) -> None:
+        self.server.shutdown()
+        self.server.server_close()
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def stub():
+    s = _Stub()
+    yield s
+    s.stop()
+
+
+# --- harness -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def _local_hounfour(port: int, *, context_window: int = 32768, caps: Optional[List[str]] = None,
+                    locality: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:

+            "local": {
+                "type": "openai_compat",
+                "endpoint": f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/v1",
+                "keyless": True,
+                "allow_insecure_endpoint": "127.0.0.1",
+                "models": {
+                    "qwen3-coder-30b": {
+                        "endpoint_family": "chat", "auth_type": "http_api", "dispatch_group": "local",
+                        "capabilities": caps or ["chat", "structured_json"],
+                        "context_window": context_window, "max_output_tokens": 512,
+                        "streaming_recovery": {"first_token_deadline_s": 120},
+                        "pricing": {"input_per_mtok": 0, "output_per_mtok": 0},
+                    }
+                },
+            }
+        },
+        "aliases": {"local-reviewer": "local:qwen3-coder-30b"},
+        "feature_flags": {"metering": False},
+    }
